question: Within 100 kilometers of Park Hyatt New York, New York, NY, where can I find a attraction toward Gary Lapelusa Landscaping LLC, Bayonne, NJ?
sql: WITH start_location AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Park Hyatt New York%' LIMIT 1 ), target_location AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Gary Lapelusa Landscaping LLC%' LIMIT 1 ), bearings AS ( SELECT s.geometry AS start_geom, t.geometry AS target_geom, degrees(ST_Azimuth(s.geometry, t.geometry)) AS target_bearing FROM start_location s, target_location t ) SELECT p.poi_name FROM pois AS p, bearings AS b WHERE ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, b.start_geom::geography, 100000) -- Within 100 kilometers (100,000 meters) AND p.tourism IS NOT NULL -- Filter for attractions AND ABS(MOD(degrees(ST_Azimuth(b.start_geom, p.geometry)) - b.target_bearing + 180 + 360, 360) - 180) < 22.5 -- Within a 45-degree cone (22.5 degrees on either side) of the target bearing AND p.poi_name NOT ILIKE '%Park Hyatt New York%' -- Exclude the starting point AND p.poi_name NOT ILIKE '%Gary Lapelusa Landscaping LLC%' -- Exclude the target point ;
